rules.summary: Use native CSS text-decoration shorthand, text-decoration-thickness, and text-underline-offset instead of border-bottom and padding-bottom underline hacks.

keepWhen: CSS border-bottom and padding-bottom underline simulation on inline text or link selectors paired with text-decoration: none
CSS linear-gradient underline background hacks on inline text or link elements paired with text-decoration: none
dropWhen: Block-level container borders (cards, tables, panels, modals, headers, footers)
Tab navigation component active state indicators (.tab, [role="tab"])
Rule declaring display: block, flex, or grid
Rule already declaring text-underline-offset or text-decoration-thickness

findings.message: Simulating text underline with border-bottom; native text-decoration with text-underline-offset and text-decoration-thickness avoids box-model side-effects and follows text wrapping.
Simulating text underline with border-bottom; native text-decoration with text-underline-offset and text-decoration-thickness avoids box-model side-effects and follows text wrapping.

rules.summary: Vendor ::-webkit-scrollbar pseudo-elements customize or hide scrollbars; use standard scrollbar-color and scrollbar-width (including scrollbar-width: none) instead.

keepWhen: The CSS rule uses vendor pseudo-elements (::-webkit-scrollbar or ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb) to customize scrollbar dimensions/thumb colors or to hide scrollbars (display: none, width: 0, height: 0).
The custom or hidden scrollbar styling is implemented without declaring standard scrollbar-color or scrollbar-width (such as scrollbar-width: none) CSS properties.
dropWhen: The stylesheet already defines standard scrollbar-width or scrollbar-color properties.
The rule only resets scrollbar properties using CSS cascade keywords (auto, inherit, initial, unset, revert) or sets transparent thumb backgrounds without hiding ::-webkit-scrollbar.

The rule sets a CSS gradient (linear-gradient, radial-gradient, -webkit-gradient), image, or box-shadow (-webkit-box-shadow) on ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb or ::-webkit-scrollbar-track, styles visible ::-webkit-scrollbar-button arrows, or styles ::-webkit-scrollbar thickness when the accompanying ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb uses gradients, images, box-shadow, backdrop-filter, or transparent backgrounds.
The rule targets ::-webkit-scrollbar for non-zero sizing without custom thumb styling, or only sets border-radius without color, thickness, or hiding.

The rule is inside a CSS reset stylesheet, targets a third-party custom JS scrollbar widget container that hides native scrollbars to render synthetic DOM scrollbars, or is inside an @supports not (scrollbar-width: ...) / @supports not (scrollbar-color: ...) fallback block.

findings.message: CSS rule uses vendor ::-webkit-scrollbar pseudo-elements to customize scrollbar appearance; add standard scrollbar-color and scrollbar-width (and wrap ::-webkit-scrollbar in @supports not (scrollbar-color: auto)).

rules.summary: CSS rules chaining invert(), sepia(), saturate(), and hue-rotate() filters to recolor icons should be modernized with CSS mask icons (mask: url(...) and background-color: currentColor) or inline SVG fill="currentColor".

keepWhen: A CSS rule chains filter: invert(...) sepia(...) saturate(...) hue-rotate(...) to approximate a specific color on an icon, button graphic, UI indicator, or SVG .
dropWhen: The filter is applied to photographs, video elements, avatars, or whole-page dark-mode inversion rather than recoloring a single-color UI icon or graphic.

The stylesheet is a third-party userstyle or browser DevTools theme override (e.g. using :host-context(.-theme-with-dark-background), @-moz-document, or --override-color-* custom properties) where the author does not control the underlying icon DOM or image URL.
The rule already uses CSS mask / mask-image for icon coloring.

findings.message: CSS rule chains invert(), sepia(), saturate(), and hue-rotate() filters to approximate a color on an icon or image; modernize with a CSS mask icon and background-color: currentColor (or inline SVG fill="currentColor").

rules.summary: Add Subresource Integrity (integrity="sha384-..."), crossorigin="anonymous", and referrerpolicy="no-referrer" to versioned third-party CDN <script> and <link rel="stylesheet"> elements.

keepWhen: An HTML or JSX <script src="https://..."> or <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://..."> loads an immutable, version-pinned asset from a public third-party CDN (cdnjs.cloudflare.com, cdn.jsdelivr.net, unpkg.com, code.jquery.com, maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com, stackpath.bootstrapcdn.com, ajax.googleapis.com) without an integrity attribute.
An external cross-origin <script src="https://..."> or <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://..."> specifies integrity="sha..." but omits the required crossorigin="anonymous" attribute.
dropWhen: The <script> or <link> element already includes both an integrity="sha256-... | sha384-... | sha512-..." attribute and a crossorigin attribute.
The URL points to a mutable/unversioned endpoint (such as analytics tags, live widgets, or Google Fonts CSS) or a first-party same-origin asset.

findings.message: External third-party CDN <link> resource (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css) lacks Subresource Integrity; add integrity="sha384-...", crossorigin="anonymous", and referrerpolicy="no-referrer".

External third-party CDN <link> resource (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css) lacks Subresource Integrity; add integrity="sha384-...", crossorigin="anonymous", and referrerpolicy="no-referrer".
